subject: BURN-DOWN CAN NEVER CORROBORATE UNATTENDED (R119): burn-down requires two rate-limit readings <=1h apart, but ONLY burn-down.sh writes a reading — so sampling happens only when evaluation happens, and evaluation happens only when the queue runs dry. Leave the CLI open a week and the first check after any gap says 'too stale to corroborate' and there is no second check. This is why 20% usage on the last day produced no work
done_when: the status line records a reading on a cadence independent of burn-down evaluation, so a genuine previous sample always exists; verified by a test that a single evaluation after a long gap can BURN
